meta.title: Advance On
meta.description: Standing amidst countless others, bearing all of Magrasea's expectations and hopes on your shoulders.

units.rawText: Professor, this is as far as we can take you.
units.displayText: Professor, this is as far as we can take you.

spans.text: Professor, this is as far as we can take you.

units.rawText: It isn't just a Mysterious Warrior's courage and sense of justice that makes them a hero, but most importantly—they'll always come back triumphant in the end.
units.displayText: It isn't just a Mysterious Warrior's courage and sense of justice that makes them a hero, but most importantly—they'll always come back triumphant in the end.

spans.text: It isn't just a Mysterious Warrior's courage and sense of justice that makes them a hero, but most importantly—they'll always come back triumphant in the end.

units.rawText: So, make sure you come back, Professor!
units.displayText: So, make sure you come back, Professor!

spans.text: So, make sure you come back, Professor!

units.rawText: Nascita reaches out to fist bump me before disappearing from the neural domain.
units.displayText: Nascita reaches out to fist bump me before disappearing from the neural domain.

spans.text: Nascita reaches out to fist bump me before disappearing from the neural domain.

units.rawText: At last, I can fight by your side without holding back. I've been wanting to do this ever since we met in the Copley Sector. Let's do our best, Professor!
units.displayText: At last, I can fight by your side without holding back. I've been wanting to do this ever since we met in the Copley Sector. Let's do our best, Professor!

spans.text: At last, I can fight by your side without holding back. I've been wanting to do this ever since we met in the Copley Sector. Let's do our best, Professor!

units.rawText: Professor, don't forget what you promised me! I want triple time and triple holidays! Make sure I get them after I join the Oasis!
units.displayText: Professor, don't forget what you promised me! I want triple time and triple holidays! Make sure I get them after I join the Oasis!

spans.text: Professor, don't forget what you promised me! I want triple time and triple holidays! Make sure I get them after I join the Oasis!

units.rawText: Bleurgh... Saying all this serious stuff makes me want to throw up. I just need to protect you, right?
units.displayText: Bleurgh... Saying all this serious stuff makes me want to throw up. I just need to protect you, right?

spans.text: Bleurgh... Saying all this serious stuff makes me want to throw up. I just need to protect you, right?

units.rawText: Professor, I know you are someone who can make miracles happen, so please, carry on.
units.displayText: Professor, I know you are someone who can make miracles happen, so please, carry on.

spans.text: Professor, I know you are someone who can make miracles happen, so please, carry on.

units.rawText: Don't worry about us. Your enemy lies ahead.
units.displayText: Don't worry about us. Your enemy lies ahead.

spans.text: Don't worry about us. Your enemy lies ahead.

units.rawText: Even though they don't belong to the Oasis, they still trust me.
units.displayText: Even though they don't belong to the Oasis, they still trust me.

spans.text: Even though they don't belong to the Oasis, they still trust me.
